comment: Reference decode of clip.mp4, taken outside the browser: ffmpeg -ss T -i clip.mp4 -frames:v 1. Each entry is the mean R, G and B of one cell of a 4x3 grid over the 320x180 frame, row-major. Chromium drawing the same paused seek into a canvas agreed with these to within 2.2 per channel. Goosie's AVFoundation decode measured 3.87 worst channel at t=0.5 and 3.85 at t=1.5; the tolerance is twice that. Per-pixel, the error is chroma siting at the pattern's hard colour edges (6% of pixels on gradient>=64 boundaries average 73) while the 68% of pixels on flat colour average 0.78, so a block mean is the right instrument and a per-pixel one is not.
